lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: # VitaDeck Demo

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: A tour of `@vitadeck/sdk`, one section per feature. L and R (keys L and R on the desktop) step through the sections, or pick one from the list on the left with the D-pad and Cross (arrow keys and Enter, or the mouse).

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | Section                                           | Shows                                                                                                    |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | [Rect & theme](src/sections/RectSection.tsx)      | `Screen`, `useTheme`, `Rect` fill and outline variants, `borderRadius`                                   |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | [Text](src/sections/TextSection.tsx)              | `align`, `wrap`, `lineHeight`, `fontSize`, a Deck App Font, Hungarian accents, emoji, CJK                |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | [Image](src/sections/ImageSection.tsx)            | A Deck App Image sized by width, height, or both                                                         |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | [Button](src/sections/ButtonSection.tsx)          | `onPress`, `onPressStart`/`onPressEnd`, `focusColor`, `autoFocus`, `onFocus`/`onBlur`, `font`/`fontSize` |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | [Pad Buttons](src/sections/PadButtonSection.tsx)  | `usePadButton` for Circle, Triangle and Square; [App.tsx](src/App.tsx) uses L and R                      |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | [Stack](src/sections/StackSection.tsx)            | Column and row, `gap`, `padding`, `align`, nesting                                                       |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | [Scroll](src/sections/ScrollSection.tsx)          | A 40-row list with momentum inside a column `Stack`                                                      |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | [Text Input](src/sections/TextInputSection.tsx)   | A controlled `TextInput` whose confirmed value is saved                                                  |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | [Storage](src/sections/StorageSection.tsx)        | `storage.getItem`/`setItem`/`removeItem` for a counter, with a reset                                     |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | [Timers](src/sections/TimersSection.tsx)          | A `setInterval` clock and a `setTimeout` toast                                                           |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | [fetch](src/sections/FetchSection.tsx)            | Loading, result and error states for a GitHub API request                                                |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: | [Failure Screen](src/sections/FailureSection.tsx) | A Button that throws, showing the Deck App Failure Screen                                                |

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: `Label` and `Section` in [src/ui.tsx](src/ui.tsx) wrap `Text` in a sized `Rect`, because a `Stack` lays out `Rect`s but not `Text`.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: The `mono` font is the smoke example's DejaVu Sans Mono, linked rather than copied so the repository holds one copy. In your own Deck App, put the font file in your project.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Run it

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: On the desktop host, from the repository root:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ```bash

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: pnpm --dir js build

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: cmake -S . -B out && cmake --build out --target run

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: `run` stages every example into `out/vitadeck-data/installed-deck-apps`; open the VitaDeck Shell with F1 and activate VitaDeck Demo.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: On a Vita (or the desktop host), open the Shell, confirm **Upload**, and point `vitadeck dev` at the URL it shows:

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ```bash

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: cd js/examples/demo

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: pnpm exec vitadeck dev 192.168.1.50

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Every save rebuilds and uploads the Deck App, then restarts it.
